shorten the list: There are too many candidates for the job, so we need to shorten the list to just five names.
這份工作的候選人太多了，所以我們需要把名單縮短到只剩五個人。
shorten the distance: The new bridge will shorten the distance between the two towns by almost ten kilometers.
這座新橋將把兩個城鎮之間的距離縮短將近十公里。
shorten a name: Many English speakers shorten a name like Elizabeth to Liz or Beth when talking to friends.
許多說英語的人和朋友聊天時，會把像伊莉莎白這樣的名字簡稱為莉茲或貝絲。
shorten one's life: Doctors warn that smoking and lack of sleep can shorten your life by many years.
醫生警告，抽菸和睡眠不足可能會讓你減壽好幾年。
shorten the working week: Some companies want to shorten the working week to four days so that workers can rest more.
有些公司想把工時縮短為一週四天，好讓員工能多休息。
shoulder the responsibility: As the oldest child, she had to shoulder the responsibility of taking care of her younger brothers.
身為家中老大，她必須承擔照顧弟弟們的責任。
shoulder the burden: After his father got sick, he had to shoulder the burden of supporting the whole family.
他父親生病後，他必須扛起養活全家的重擔。
shoulder the cost: In many families, parents shoulder the cost of their children's college education.
在許多家庭裡，父母承擔孩子大學教育的費用。
shoulder one's way through: He was late for the last train, so he shouldered his way through the crowded station, pushing past others.
他快趕不上末班車了，所以用肩膀擠過擁擠的車站，從別人身旁推過去。
shoulder the blame: The coach chose to shoulder the blame for the team's loss instead of criticizing his young players.
教練選擇承擔球隊輸球的責難，而不是批評他的年輕球員。
shove someone aside: It is very rude to shove someone aside just because you want to get on the bus first.
只因為你想先上公車就把別人推開，是非常無禮的。
shove it in a drawer: I had no time to tidy up the letter before the guests came, so I decided to shove it in a drawer.
客人來之前我沒時間整理那封信，所以決定把它塞進抽屜。
when push comes to shove: He says he doesn't care about money, but when push comes to shove, he always chooses the higher salary.
他說他不在乎錢，但到了緊要關頭，他總是選擇較高的薪水。
shove off: The angry shop owner told the noisy teenagers to shove off and stop bothering his customers.
生氣的店主叫那群吵鬧的青少年滾開，不要再打擾他的顧客。
show promise: The young pianist began to show promise at the age of six and won her first contest at eight.
這位年輕的鋼琴家六歲時就開始顯得很有前途，八歲時贏得了她的第一場比賽。
show mercy: The judge decided to show mercy to the poor boy who had stolen bread for his hungry sister.
法官決定對那個為了餓肚子的妹妹偷麵包的窮男孩開恩。
show respect: In Taiwan, students often bow to their teachers to show respect at the start of class.
在台灣，學生常在上課開始時向老師鞠躬以表示尊重。
show signs of: The old bridge has begun to show signs of damage, so engineers will repair it next month.
這座老橋已經開始顯示損壞的跡象，所以工程師下個月會修理它。
show off: He loves to show off his expensive new phone to everyone in our class.
他很愛向我們班上每個人炫耀他昂貴的新手機。
show up: Kevin promised to meet us at seven, but he didn't show up until almost nine o'clock.
凱文答應七點和我們見面，但他快九點才出現。
show someone the door: If a customer starts shouting at the waiters, the restaurant owner will show him the door at once.
如果有客人開始對服務生大吼，餐廳老闆會立刻把他趕出去。
show one's true colors: He seemed friendly at first, but people often show their true colors when their friends are in trouble.
他一開始看起來很友善，但人們常在朋友遇到麻煩時露出真面目。
shrink from responsibility: A good leader never shrinks from responsibility, even when things go wrong for the team.
一位好的領導者絕不逃避責任，即使團隊出了問題也一樣。
shrink in the wash: Wash this wool sweater in cold water by hand, or it may shrink in the wash.
這件羊毛毛衣要用冷水手洗，否則可能會洗後縮水。
shrink from danger: The brave firefighter did not shrink from danger and ran straight into the burning house to save the child.
勇敢的消防員沒有畏縮不前，直接衝進著火的房子救那個孩子。
shrink the budget: Because of falling income, the city had to shrink the budget for parks by twenty percent this year.
由於收入減少，市政府今年必須把公園預算縮減百分之二十。
a shrinking population: With fewer babies being born each year, Taiwan faces a shrinking population and an aging society.
隨著每年出生的嬰兒越來越少，台灣面臨人口縮減和高齡化社會。
shrug off criticism: The young writer learned to shrug off criticism from strangers online and kept writing every day.
這位年輕作家學會對網路上陌生人的批評不以為意，繼續每天寫作。
shrug one's shoulders: Whenever I ask my brother where my keys are, he just shrugs his shoulders and says he doesn't know.
每次我問弟弟我的鑰匙在哪裡，他只是聳聳肩，說他不知道。
shrug off an injury: The tough player was able to shrug off an injury to his ankle and kept playing until the end.
那位強悍的球員能不把腳踝的傷放在心上，一直打到比賽結束。
shrug off the loss: The coach told the team to shrug off the loss quickly and start preparing for the next important game.
教練要球隊很快不在意這次的損失，開始為下一場重要比賽做準備。
